decisions.rationale: Leukemia cutis (myeloid sarcoma) is a direct equivalent of the supplied leaf labels, which are also known as leukemic cutis or leukemia cutis.
Sweet's syndrome (acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis) does not have a direct relation to the supplied leaf labels.
Sweet syndrome (atypical/neutropenic) does not have a direct relation to the supplied leaf labels.
Histiocytoid Sweet syndrome does not have a direct relation to the supplied leaf labels.
